### Bug summary

When you write:

```json
{
  "A": "/*",
  "B": "B",
  "C": "C"
}
```

Prism’s JSON grammar tokenizes the `/*` inside the string as the start of a comment because the comment‐regex lives at the top of the grammar. By pulling the comment rule _below_ the string rule, the string regex (which is marked `greedy: true`) will grab the entire `"/*"` and the comment regex will never see it.
